entries.consent.title: Before you start
entries.consent.purpose.ack: I understand that Rinda is for learning about my health. It is not a diagnosis and not an emergency service.
entries.consent.age.question: Are you between 18 and 35 years old?
entries.consent.age.ineligible: Thank you for your interest. This study is only for people aged 18 to 35, so you cannot continue. If you need health support, these services can help.
entries.consent.choices.intro: Choose what you agree to. Each choice is separate, and nothing is chosen for you.
entries.consent.core.label: I agree to take part in the Rinda Health study
entries.consent.core.body: Your answers and results are stored securely and used without your name for the study. You can withdraw and ask for your data to be deleted at any time.
entries.consent.core.required: You need to agree to take part to use Rinda.
entries.consent.mental_wellness.label: I agree to answer the optional mood and stress questions
entries.consent.mental_wellness.body: You can still skip any question. If you do not agree, these questions are not shown.
entries.consent.audio.label: I agree to the study interview being audio recorded
entries.consent.audio.body: Only the study team listens to it. The Rinda app itself never records you.
entries.consent.follow_up.label: I agree to be contacted later about the study
entries.consent.follow_up.body: Only through the email or phone number on this account.
